PluginData.Author: Polar
PluginData.Tooltip: Crouch while the crouch key is held, stand up when it is released.
PluginData.Description:
Makes on-foot crouching hold-to-crouch instead of a toggle.
Usage: hold your Crouch key (C by default) to crouch, release it to stand up. Uses the game's own Crouch binding, keyboard or controller. Pressing Crouch while already crouched still stands you up, as in vanilla.
Under a low ceiling the character stays crouched after release and stands up as soon as there is headroom. The same applies if you release while falling or with the jetpack on.
No effect in cockpits, seats, on ladders, in spectator, in menus or while chat is open. Jetpack down movement is unchanged.
No configuration. No Harmony patches. Client-side only, works in single player, on a listen host and on any dedicated server without a server install.
Compatibility: does not change any game method, so it sits alongside other input and camera plugins.
Bugs and suggestions: https://github.com/Po11arr/PolarsHoldCrouch/issues
